hotels.title: Koh Lanta Five-Star Beachfront Suites off the Coast of Thailand near Krabi
hotels.description: Experience a five-star luxury escape at Pimalai Resort and Spa, perfectly set on Koh Lanta island, located off the coast of Krabi. Stamped with a Tripadvisor Travellers’ Choice, Best of the Best 2022 award - ranked within the top 1% of hotels and resorts in the world, based on traveller feedback - this secluded retreat has been expertly crafted for romantics, groups and families seeking an intimate hideaway. Set away from the crowds, you'll find serenity at this award-winning resort nestled between the lush undulating hills and sugar-fine shores. Live like royalty in palatial luxury, with each suite and villa boasting stylish furnishings and ample space. Find the epitome of relaxation at Pimalai Spa or spend your day lazing by the pool, or adventure away from the resort and discover the kaleidoscopic underwater coral reefs right on your doorstep.
